title: Educator Development
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

outcomes: Demonstrate the ability to create curriculum that addresses the needs of diverse student populations through grade-appropriate teaching strategies and curricular models that deepen student learning; meet varying abilities and learning styles; and actively engage learners.

Inform their instructional practices through analysis and reflection to support students’ developmental needs by designing and implementing formative, and summative assessments to measure student learning.
